name: +1 Scream Per Click
desc:
📢 Welcome to +1 Scream Per Click!

😱 Click to gain Scream and become louder!
📣 Train in the training zones to increase your Scream
🪟 Shout at glass to break it, earn Wins, and unlock new stages
🏆 Compete and climb the leaderboard to become the loudest!

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite the game for future updates!
Thank you for playing!
